title: National Science Day 2019 — Teachers' Training Workshop
teaser: A full-day Teachers' Training workshop on National Science Day (28 February 2019), in collaboration with the Academy and ScienceUtsav, featuring sessions on optical phenomena, STEAM and robotics, and a pedagogy discussion.
homepageMatter: On National Science Day 2019 (28 February), tAcT organised a full-day Teachers' Training workshop in collaboration with the Indian Academy of Sciences and ScienceUtsav. About 60 science teachers attended sessions on optical phenomena, STEAM and robotics workshops, and a pedagogy discussion.
